title: Why Purview DC | Purview Services
description: Purview has spent 17 years on complex infrastructure projects where execution certainty, quality assurance and operational discipline matter most.
h1: Global engineering, built for the AI infrastructure era.
lede: Purview has spent 17 years on complex infrastructure projects where execution certainty, quality assurance and operational discipline matter most. UK-headquartered; 21 countries; delivery centres in five countries; CMMi Level 5, ISO certified, UK Crown Commercial Service supplier.

blocks.text: Backed by a group that delivers.

Purview Data Centres is the AI-infrastructure delivery and operations arm of Purview Group, with government-grade delivery experience in the UK, India, the Middle East and APAC and high-density deployments inside live facilities run by major colocation and cloud operators.
Why operators hand Purview the programme.
